entities.summary: This is a list of mosques in Russia. The construction of mosques in Russia has been documented from the 1550s to 2010 and mirrors the history of Islam in Russia. Russian mosques span the mosques of Europe and Asia. Ar-Rahim Mosque is a mosque in Europe, established in 2007. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
